course.title: Computer Networks
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Suppose the CSE department of KUET has 200 personal computer and 10 servers. The network administrator wants you to dynamically assign the IP address of those personal PC. How personal computer get the IP address if you have a network address 172.16.0.0/24. Also, state the dynamic range of IP addresses.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
